attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Congress failed to act on border security and immigration reform because Republicans, led by Donald Trump, preferred political maneuvering to problem-solving.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump's plans for a second term will devastate the economy and separate families.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump has stated that, if elected, he will immediately deport millions of undocumented immigrants, including those who have lived in and contributed to the country for years.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump and his allies have promised to end birthright citizenship for the children of undocumented individuals.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump and his allies have promised to ignore the Constitution and Supreme Court precedent regarding immigration.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump and his allies have promised to bar undocumented children from public schools.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump and his allies have promised to again separate children from their families.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump's plans are out of line with American values.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans are currently blocking President Biden's bipartisan border security proposals because they lack the courage to stand up to Donald Trump.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
